prose: A Show HN project, an offline desktop companion that helps users keep a healthy blink rhythm, shown on eyesrhythm.com with an 'Ocular Rhythm Index' of 78 out of 100. Basis: only the headline and the index readout were retrievable, so how it measures blinking is unverified.
highlights: Offline desktop app aimed at blink rhythm.
Page shows an Ocular Rhythm Index (78/100).
Basis: headline and one readout only.
